intent.en: Per Chief's assignment: append-only disposition of the QA review low items and observations for five NP5 cards: NP5-02 L1/L2 (recipe-difference site layering, section cross-reference), NP5-03 L3 (inventory.unimplemented=7 historical snapshot vs remaining 4), NP5-01a closing L1 (dual-count dedupe qualification; literal counterexample 15 shared keys -> 554 strict / 593 one-per-key) and L2 (slice-count wording: 11 site slices + 4 device slices + 5 governance cards), D-2 observations recorded (positive), and W4 section-3 24->25 typo verified already corrected by section 9 (commit 316b28dd). Historical bytes untouched; manifests recomputed; zero GPU/window.

**NP5-03 addenda**：新增 `np-gate/np5-03/addenda.md`——inventory `counts.unimplemented=7` 为历史快照（3 条已 closed-implemented），现行剩余 4（卡 H blocked、不计覆盖），以 `unimplemented_remaining=4` 为准；历史 4 文件字节不变，manifest 4→5

**D-2 2 观察 / W4 §3 笔误**：D-2 O1/O2 为正向观察（字段落法一致、附录单元登记合规）→ 记录不修；`W4-dependency-governance.md` §3 标题 24→25 已由 §9（提交 `316b28dd`，13,791 B）append-only 更正 → 核实无需再改
